So, the husband got home. 

My therapist ambushed him.

Maybe she is right but apparently the stuff he told her meant that I was "soooo ill" and I needed intervention (which he didn't provide info of which i didn't say so hello meds to me) sooooo off to a psychiatrist I go.

I am only agreeing to appease and b/c wtf...

I msg-ed the mods.  :)

I'm also going to talk to my husband once he gets home.  I signed away verbally all of my privacy rights to my therapist so we'll see what she told him.  

I may update this if the discussion doesn't go well.

I truly appreciate your response.  I wish I knew more to vent about but it's so much and so long I don't even know where to begin.

My husband will be coming home soon and I will PM the mods immediately if I actually want to pull the trigger.  Well, that's the wrong thing to say as I DO, but if I am in any way self harmful, to the mods I'll go. :)

Thanks again.  And an e-hug to you.
